name: Wilbur Shaw
features: fair skin, dark hair, dark eyes, narrow face, wide mouth, wiry build, brash grinning expression
bio: Warren Wilbur Shaw won the Indianapolis 500 three times — 1937, and back to back in 1939 and 1940, the latter two in the Maserati 8CTF 'Boyle Special', the only European car ever to win the race. He talked the Speedway out of demolition in 1945 and ran it as president until his death in a plane crash in 1954.
